application_awaiting_response_idx.name: application_awaiting_response_idx
application_awaiting_response_idx.where: "application"."outcome" is null and "application"."response_due_at" is not null

application_hire_dates_check.name: application_hire_dates_check
application_hire_dates_check.value: ("application"."offer_accepted_on" is null and "application"."start_on" is null) or ("application"."outcome" = 'hired' and ("application"."offer_accepted_on" is null or "application"."start_on" is null or "application"."start_on" >= "application"."offer_accepted_on"))

application_cv_check.name: application_cv_check
application_cv_check.value: ("application"."cv_key" is not null and "application"."cv_file_name" is not null and "application"."cv_media_type" is not null and "application"."cv_size_bytes" is not null) or ("application"."migration_batch_id" is not null and "application"."cv_key" is null and "application"."cv_file_name" is null and "application"."cv_media_type" is null and "application"."cv_size_bytes" is null)

task_open_due_idx.name: task_open_due_idx
task_open_due_idx.where: "task"."completed_at" is null and "task"."due_at" is not null

migration_batch_part_check.name: migration_batch_part_check
migration_batch_part_check.value: ("migration_batch"."group_id" is null) = ("migration_batch"."part" is null) and ("migration_batch"."part" is null or "migration_batch"."part" >= 1)

skill_alias_text_check.name: skill_alias_text_check
skill_alias_text_check.value: char_length("skill_alias"."skill") between 1 and 60 and char_length("skill_alias"."alias") between 1 and 60 and char_length("skill_alias"."alias_key") between 1 and 60
